meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 操作网页、填写表单、截屏与采集数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让程序代替你操作网页、抓取信息或填写表单。
copy.tagline_en: Operate web pages, fill forms, capture screenshots, and extract data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need programmatic control of web pages for testing, scraping, or automation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以代替你操作浏览器：打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截图、提取网页内容等。它会保持页面状态，能分步完成登录、测试网站等复杂任务。
howto.when: 当你要求打开网页、填写表单、截图等浏览器操作，或说出“go to [url]”、“click on”等触发短语时触发。

say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回截图。

say.text: 点击页面上的“登录”按钮。
抓取这个页面的所有链接。
say.note: 会提取并展示所有链接。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can operate a browser for you: open pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data. It keeps page state across steps, enabling multi-step tasks like login or site testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests to navigate, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows, or by trigger phrases like 'go to [url]', 'click on'.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will launch a browser and return the screenshot.
It will locate the element and click it.

say_en.text: Scrape all links from this page.
say_en.note: It will extract and list all links.
